tagline: SOUTH ASIAN ROOTS. GLOBAL CLUB SOUND.
genres: UK Garage / House / Afro House / South Asian Electronic
shortBio: A DJ and producer bringing South Asian musical heritage into contemporary underground club sounds.
longBio: K!SH connects the sounds and rhythms of South Asia with the energy of the global dancefloor. Drawing on Punjabi, Bollywood and Bhangra influences alongside UK Garage, House, Afro House and Amapiano, his sets move between familiar musical references and forward-facing club sounds. With around 25 years of DJ experience, K!SH is building a new chapter as a DJ and producer, bringing a distinctive South Asian perspective to contemporary electronic music.
